summary: v1 legacyCas end to end from CQL: 1 ballot, prepare (2 PAXOS_PREPARE_REQ + local, 3 promises), QUORUM precondition read, propose (3 accepts), commit to 3, [applied] true. The contract seam (write-path keyspace doesn't know shop.users, so the commit is silently skipped) was worked around through scenario state.

Correction: v1 still proposes an EMPTY update when the condition fails, and a quorum accepts it (SP:359-364, 525-534). Only the commit is skipped. The model reproduces [applied] false with the current value (balance=100), 3 empty accepts and no commit. Minor: the result rows are raw {partition_key, cells}, without the [applied] column.
ReplicaPlans.forPaxos throws Unavailable(SERIAL, required 2, alive 1) before any ballot or message. The model matches exactly, with liveness taken from the gossiper state.

Clarified: the back-off is a uniform random 0-99ms sleep, not exponential. The timeout is CasWriteTimeoutException(CAS, SERIAL, received 0, blockFor 2, contentions). The model reproduces the rejection, back-off, re-prepare above the competing ballot (separate scenario) and the CAS write timeout. Sustained contention needs a concurrent proposer, so the deadline is reached with a 950ms latency fault plus one seeded higher promise.

Driven from a CQL SELECT at SERIAL: the in-progress proposal is re-proposed and committed at QUORUM, a second prepare follows, the empty update is accepted and never committed, then fetchRows at QUORUM returns the replayed value. The keyspace seam was worked around through state.

LOGGED 2-partition batch: forBatchlogWrite picks 10.0.0.2 and .3 (CL TWO), BATCH_STORE to both, then the mutations (2 x send-to-hinted-replicas, 3 acks each), then async BATCH_REMOVE to both. The order was confirmed in the trace. The rack preference can't trigger with 3 nodes, because validate returns early with <=2 candidates. The keyspace seam was worked around.

Clarified: with .3 down the batchlog goes to .2 only (CL ONE). Both mutations reach QUORUM, .3 is hinted twice without a message, and the batchlog IS removed (requiredBeforeFinish = batch CL QUORUM is met). Replay covers only mutations that never reached the batch CL. The model reproduces all of this.

Clarified: scheduleWithFixedDelay(RING_DELAY 30s, then 10s). The age cut-off is 2 x write_request_timeout = 4000ms, and the throttle is 1024 KiB/s / ring size (341). The model replays the old batch in pass 1 and the young one in pass 2, with fixed-delay spacing and throttle 341. The RateLimiter's effect and the 30s initial delay aren't simulated.

Correction: the size check applies only when the batch has more than 1 Mutation (multi-partition), to LOGGED and UNLOGGED alike, and is skipped for conditional batches (BatchStatement.java:331-366). Thresholds use strict >, at 5120/51200 bytes. All 4 variants reproduce, including the warn path still writing atomically.

UNLOGGED: mutateWithTriggers(mutateAtomically=false) goes to StorageProxy.mutate with write type UNLOGGED_BATCH. There is no forBatchlogWrite, BATCH_STORE or BATCH_REMOVE, and 4 MUTATION_REQ + 2 local applies. The keyspace seam was worked around.
